title: 棚里出事了  (Trouble in the Studio)

segments.t: Just before the semifinal taping, disaster strikes the studio crew, and the office scrambles to find replacements.
棚里出事了。
怎么了？
现场的兄弟们中午去吃饭，结果食物中毒，全部都进了医院。
本来现场就缺人，半决赛马上又要录，
得赶紧想办法调派人。
以老大的名义，给全部门发了邮件。你去派人吧。
好。
我可以去现场组帮忙。
你不行。
让她去。总编室不缺人，真正的制作也不是她能干的。
总编室不缺人？总编室永远都缺人的好吧。
你知道我们每天堆了多少工作要做吗？
不是一直就你们两个人吗？看，因为其他人都被你虐死、虐残、虐跑了呀，大哥！
这个算是跑得最慢的吗？
In the office, Kaiwen bursts in with terrible news about the production crew.
棚里出事了。
'Something happened in the studio.' He delivers the urgent problem using "peng li" for 'in the studio'.
怎么了？
'What is wrong?' The question "zenme le" asks 'what happened?'.
现场的兄弟们中午去吃饭，结果食物中毒，全部都进了医院。
'The brothers on the floor crew went to eat at noon, got food poisoning as a result, and all went into the hospital.' He explains the disaster with "shiwu zhongdu", 'food poisoning'.
本来现场就缺人，半决赛马上又要录，
'The floor was short-staffed to begin with, and the semifinal is about to record right away,' He points out the terrible timing, using "que ren" for 'lacking people'.
得赶紧想办法调派人。
'we have to hurry and figure out a way to dispatch people.' The phrase "xiang banfa" means 'think of a method'.
以老大的名义，给全部门发了邮件。你去派人吧。
'In the boss\'s name, I sent an email to the whole department. You go dispatch people.' He hands over authority, using "mingyi" for 'name'.
好。
'Okay.' He accepts the task with a simple "hao".
我可以去现场组帮忙。
'I can go to the floor crew to help.' Xiaogu volunteers using "bangmang", 'help'.
你不行。
'You cannot.' He rejects her offer flatly with "buxing".
让她去。总编室不缺人，真正的制作也不是她能干的。
'Let her go. The chief editor\'s office is not short of people, and real production is not something she can do either.' Kaiwen uses "zhenzheng de zhizuo" for 'real production'.
总编室不缺人？总编室永远都缺人的好吧。
'The chief editor\'s office is not short of people? The chief editor\'s office is always short of people, okay.' He argues they are always understaffed, using "yongyuan" for 'forever'.
你知道我们每天堆了多少工作要做吗？
'Do you know how much work we have piled up to do every day?' He emphasizes his workload with "dui", 'pile up'.
不是一直就你们两个人吗？看，因为其他人都被你虐死、虐残、虐跑了呀，大哥！

'Has it not always been just the two of you? Look, because everyone else was abused to death, abused to disability, and abused to running away by you, big brother!' Kaiwen jokingly calls out his harsh management style, repeating "nüe" for 'abuse'.
这个算是跑得最慢的吗？
'Is this one considered the slowest to run away?' He refers to Xiaogu scampering out the door, using "pao", 'run'. Let's listen to the whole crisis unfold again.
棚里出事了。
怎么了？
现场的兄弟们中午去吃饭，结果食物中毒，全部都进了医院。
本来现场就缺人，半决赛马上又要录，
得赶紧想办法调派人。
以老大的名义，给全部门发了邮件。你去派人吧。
好。
我可以去现场组帮忙。
你不行。
让她去。总编室不缺人，真正的制作也不是她能干的。
总编室不缺人？总编室永远都缺人的好吧。
你知道我们每天堆了多少工作要做吗？
不是一直就你们两个人吗？看，因为其他人都被你虐死、虐残、虐跑了呀，大哥！
这个算是跑得最慢的吗？
With the floor crew out of commission, Xiaogu steps up to help the live production. You learned words for 'studio' and 'food poisoning'.
下次见！
